HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.
   C. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.
